The grilled chicken was the only redeeming item on the menu. They had outdoor seating but we chose indoor due to still warm weather. The place is gloomy with harsh lighting. The mutabal, lentil soup and mixed grill were worthy of a fast food shack. Even the pita bread was stale. Not recommend.

Today, we visited Desert Rose, where we enjoyed shisha and had a wonderful dining experience. The food was absolutely delicious, the ambiance was amazing, and the music made the atmosphere even more special. The view was truly outstanding! ✨

The staff was incredibly friendly and welcoming, especially **Mr. Haseeb* who is truly an amazing person. He took great care of us and made sure we received excellent service throughout our visit. His hospitality, professionalism, and way of dealing with guests were exceptional. Thanks to his wonderful recommendations and service, we even tried dishes we hadn't originally planned to order—and we loved them!

A big thank you to Desert Rose and, especially, Mr. Haseeb for making our visit so memorable. We truly appreciate the outstanding hospitality and wish you all the very best. Highly recommended! ❤️👏
